# sequence position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisSequencePosition`](gmeow-axisSequencePosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisSequencePosition>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
